name: Get My eSIM
description: Get My eSIM helps Claude search and compare public travel eSIM plans for destinations worldwide. It returns plan options with pricing, data allowance, validity, provider details, coverage, technical features, and purchase links. Travelers can use it to find affordable mobile data before a trip, compare providers for a specific country or region, and narrow results by data needs, duration, budget, or supported features like hotspot and 5G.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Get My eSIM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Get My eSIM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getmyesim.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Get My eSIM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Get My eSIM provides these MCP tools: get_esim_plans.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Get My eSIM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Get My eSIM in e-commerce on the Manufact MCP catalog include Figaro Immobilier, Shop, eYantra Corporate Gifting, Is It Legit by M8ven, and Pricewatcha.

_published_faq.name: Does Get My eSIM MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Get My eSIM does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Get My eSIM is developed by Get My eSIM. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
